notes.title: [Update]Maintenance Notice（10/9/2024）
notes.notes:
The details of the 10/9/2024 JST maintenance are as follows. 

[h1]◆Bug Fixes[/h1]The following bugs have been fixed.

・About Nemlim HD2
- Bug where unnatural text was set.

・About Serpilis Grim's Grim Reaper "SOUL SHOT"
- Bug where Player's HP recovery was triggered when defeated.
- Bug where the Explosion's damage type was incorrectly set to Blast.
※The correct Attribute is Bullet.

・About Link Shot
- Bug where, in certain customizations with different Link Shot weapons equipped, incompatible ones would also activate.
- Bug where Custom Link Shot could sometimes be fired simultaneously with Link Shotby when using the Link Shot weapon.
- Bug where, when combining Link Shot weapons that trigger special effects upon shooting with other Link Shot weapons, the special effects would sometimes remain after shooting or firing all rounds.
※Due to the changes, there may be cases where a cooldown occurs even when using a different Link Shot weapon, if a non all-round-firing Link Shot weapon is combined.



[h1]◆Others[/h1]・We have updated the lineup of Sonia's Daily Shop.
- Summer Festival 2024 event prizes have been added.

・About the Epoch Battle, the event start time has been changed.

notes.title: Planned Improvements for the Official Release
notes.notes:
We would like to thank everyone who participated in the CosmicBreak Universal beta test.

Below, we will share a number of improvements and adjustments we are making based on the feedback we have received. We plan to implement these changes in time for the official release.

[h2]Usability Improvements[/h2]
[b]Leveling[/b]
-We have received feedback that character progression is a cumbersome process. Not only do players have to tune up equipment, but they must also level up their characters. We agree, and have decided that adjustments are necessary. In light of this, the amount of EXP now required to level up has been roughly halved.
-Previously, a character could not gain additional EXP at a level up until a cartridge was selected, and their level was raised. We are making adjustments so that EXP can be accumulated without leveling up. This will also be the case when using an [EXP Gain] item.
-The “Limit Remove” system will be removed. Previously, there were level caps at level 5 and level 8, but characters will now have level 10 as their level cap across the board. 

[b]Tutorial[/b]
We have received comments about a lack of tutorials. For the official release, we will be reimplementing the 3 Guardians Mate (during the beta test, they were temporarily removed due to an issue), and make adjustments so that the Mate system is easier to understand. 

[b]Other[/b]
-We will implement an indication for AM and HD parts that have a chance of being destroyed.
-We will implement an indication of whether a Wonder Bit’s efficiency will change based on STR or TEC values.
-We will make other miscellaneous usability improvements.

[h2]General Adjustments[/h2]
[b]Eternal Tune Ups[/b]
Previously, Eternal Tune Ups (now known as "High Eternal"), which prevent certain parts from being destroyed, were costly and not easily applied despite their importance. For this reason, we will make the following adjustments.

Eternal (new)
Detail: Prevents the destruction of the part to which it is applied.
Cost: 5
Base Chance of Success: 100%

High Eternal (updated from Eternal)
Details: Prevents the destruction of the part to which it is applied and increases HP.
Cost: 15
HP: +8
Base Chance of Success: 60%

[b]Battle Campaign[/b]
We will be making some adjustments to the Battle Campaign, which offers different rewards based on a player’s Union Wars battle results.

During the beta test period, only the first 50 levels of rewards were made available, taking into account the short period of availability for the campaign. In the official release, we will provide 100 levels with plentiful rewards. Additionally, based on the data we collected during the beta test, we have decided to increase the amount of rewards across the board (not only for normal rewards and Battle Pass rewards).For example, we plan to increase the number of Robo Cubes and Garapon Tickets in the rewards, to increase opportunities to obtain characters.

We will also be making some adjustments to Battle Cards, including easing the upper limit of BP consumption from 4,500 BP, in order to provide players with more choices.

[b]Garapon[/b]
The amount of Rt required for 20x rolls will be reduced.
Furthermore, we have received suggestions that there are too many prizes in the bronze and blue tiers, making it difficult to obtain a desired item. Therefore, we will reduce the number of items in the lineup for the bronze and blue tiers, increasing the probability of receiving a desired item.

[b]Battle Rating System[/b]
Although we made adjustments to reduce performance disparities, disparities have nonetheless arisen due to factors like player skill and character progression. By introducing the Battle Rating system, we can make adjustments so players can enjoy battles that match their abilities.

[b]Support Cartridges[/b]
We have confirmed that the survival rate of SUP types is abnormally high compared to other types. SUP type already deviates from the three-way deadlock relationship between LND, AIR, and ART types, and as such, we will remove "Guard Cartridges," which provide a net increase in survivability to SUP types (which, as mentioned, do not have a specific weakness in the first place), and replace them with different cartridges.

[b]Capacity Disparities[/b]
We will implement changes so that when all "Capacity Up" and "Internal Weapon Enhancement" cartridges have been acquired, the difference in capacity will be nearly equal regardless of the core parts, and there will be equal opportunities for tuning up.
 -M size and L size core parts in the same Cost range will be changed to have the same capacity.
 -S size will have slightly less capacity than the M and L sizes.
 -Core parts that had a low capacity in the beta test will also benefit from this change.
 -Certain core parts may have increased capacity in exchange for having lower parameters.
 -Certain characters (such as humanoids with limited customization) may have a large capacity.

[b]Other Changes[/b]
-The KDJ will be moved to the Resort Area.
-Additional miscellaneous adjustments are planned.


If you made it this far, thank you so much for taking the time to read this enormous post.
We hope to see you when CosmicBreak Universal officially launches!

-The CosmicBreak Universal Management Team

notes.title: Beta and Release Dates
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39424614/973a37d071cccc58f802ee8b16173ddcd30e5393.png[/img]

[b]Reason for the Postponement[/b]
The development team has worked hard to prepare CosmicBreak Universal in time for its originally planned release in late December 2020, but as the date neared, it became apparent that the team needed more time to implement the changes that were planned, and the decision was made to change the release date to March 2021. This will give the team precious time to provide a better service.

All of the CyberStep team, would like to apologize to the fans who have been eagerly awaiting the release of the game, and thank them for their patience.

[b]About the Beta Test[/b]
A beta test will be conducted on Steam, beginning on Wednesday, January 20th, 2021. The test is currently planned to be held for three to five weeks. The development team will continue to make improvements to the game based on player feedback received throughout the test period. All are welcome to join the beta test.

CosmicBreak Universal will be free to play for both the Early Access period and the official release, so anyone with a Steam account can participate.

Those who would like to stay up to date on the upcoming beta test can visit the CosmicBreak Universal store page on Steam and click the "add to wishlist" button to receive regular updates.

During the beta test, participants will be able to access the main content of CosmicBreak Universal, which includes Missions, Quests, and the Arena. Participants will also be able to level up and strengthen their characters through this content. The balance adjustments that have been made to characters available in the beta, in addition to the prices in the Shop, the Garapon rates, and more, have all been set to simulate values close to those that will be used in the official release.

[b]Differences Between the Official Release and the Beta Test Version[/b]
Once officially released, the full version of the game will enable certain functions that will be restricted during the beta test. These functions include the ability to purchase Rt, which can be used to buy a variety of things in the game, in addition to using Present Codes.

The following features are currently being worked on::
[list]
[*] New playable characters
[*] New shop items
[*] New NPCs and NPC Quests
[*] Coin Exchanges (including the Union Coin Exchange)
[*] Campaign Mode
[*] Steam Workshop integration
[/list]

[i]* Feedback received during Early Access beta testing will be used to improve features in the game.
** Please note that user data such as robots and items acquired during Early Access beta period will be reset and will not be carried over to the full version.[/i]

[b]About CosmicBreak Universal[/b]
CosmicBreak Universal is a new and improved international version of ‘CosmicBreak' coming to Steam, with support for English, Japanese, and Traditional Chinese within the game. Improvements such as revamped features, updated graphics, and an overhaul of the game balance will make for an enjoyable experience for fans and newcomers alike.
